label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Dear friends, neighbours, and Little Acorns families,**

I'm safe. I'm staying with my sister in Rondebosch, and I'm okay. I'm writing this once so I don't have to answer every message one by one. My phone has been going since Saturday, and I'm so tired, but I've read every single one, and they've made me cry more times than I can count.

**What happened**

On Saturday night, 7 November, a fire started in a ground-floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. It was around 11:40pm. I live on the second floor, in flat 12. Everyone got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home. The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess.

My neighbour Uncle Faizel banged on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. That's how I woke up. I grabbed my phone and my cat Marmalade and nothing else. Marmalade hid under the car for two hours afterwards, which I think is fair.

My flat has smoke and water damage everywhere, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. My landlord says nobody can go back in for at least six weeks. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade is safe, and that's what matters most to me right now.

I'm also sad about the things I lost that were for school. I'd taken home all the materials to laminate for the end-of-year concert, including the 22 crowns and the banner with all the kids' handprints on it. I can't make those again exactly, but I know the Ladybirds will still have crowns.

**What I need**

- Help with the deposit for a new place. This is the biggest one.
- School shoes (size 6) and work clothes (size 34).
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

**What I don't need**

- More clothes in general. Someone already dropped a bag at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday, without even knocking, and I'm so grateful. I honestly have more than enough now, and I'll pass the extras on to the other families in the building.
- Food. My sister's freezer is full.

**The fundraiser**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. It's here: backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court. The goal is R25 000, and it was already at R11 400 this morning. I honestly feel weird asking people for money, and Zinhle told me to stop being silly and accept it. So I'm accepting it, and I'm really thankful.

**Please be careful: this is NOT mine**

People have been sending me a second "fund" that I didn't set up. It's a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on some website, plus a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money into a Capitec account. That is not me, and I'm not running any other fundraiser. The only official link is the BackaBuddy page above.

I've reported the fake one. Please don't send money to it, and please don't forward the WhatsApp message. If you already sent money to that account, please contact your bank straight away and report it. If you're not sure whether something is from me, ask me directly or check the BackaBuddy link.

**For the Little Acorns families**

The end-of-year concert on 27 November is still happening. Please don't worry about it. The Ladybirds will have their crowns, and I'm sorry if the banner is missing from the wall this year.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. I'd really appreciate it if nobody made a big thing of it in front of the kids. They don't need to know all the details, and I'd rather walk in quietly and get on with our day. A hug from a little one would honestly be perfect, though.

**And a note on replies**

Please be patient with me. I'm going to reply to messages slowly, and if I don't get back to your DM, please don't be offended. I'm reading everything, and I love you all for it.

Thank you for checking on me, for the clothes, for the donations, for knocking on the gate and for just being there. Thank you, Uncle Faizel, for waking up the whole floor.

With so much love and gratitude,

Thandi
